repos.description: The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
repos.summary_zh: LiteLLM 是一个统一的大语言模型网关和 Python SDK，可将 100+ 种 LLM API 转换为 OpenAI 格式调用。提供代理服务器模式，集成成本追踪、负载均衡、安全护栏和日志监控等企业级功能。支持 Bedrock、Azure、Anthropic 等主流平台，简化多模型管理和切换，适用于需要统一 AI 接口、成本控制和生产级部署的场景。
repos.summary_en: LiteLLM is a unified LLM gateway and Python SDK that standardizes 100+ model APIs into OpenAI format. It offers proxy server mode with enterprise features including cost tracking, load balancing, guardrails, and logging. Supporting major platforms like Bedrock, Azure, and Anthropic, it simplifies multi-model management and switching for production deployments requiring unified AI interfaces and cost control.

repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: LinkSwift是一款基于JavaScript的网盘直链下载助手，支持百度、阿里、移动、天翼、迅雷、夸克、UC、123云盘等八大主流网盘。通过注入脚本解析页面请求，绕过客户端限制，直接获取文件下载地址，提升下载效率。适用于批量下载或高速下载，亮点为多网盘适配、持续更新、开源免费。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based cloud drive direct link downloader supporting eight major cloud drives including Baidu, Aliyun, China Mobile, Tianyi, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123pan. By injecting scripts to parse page requests, it bypasses client restrictions and directly obtains file download URLs, improving download efficiency. Suitable for batch or high-speed downloads, featuring multi-drive compatibility, continuous updates, and open-source free.

repos.description: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
repos.summary_zh: PicGo是专为创作者设计的终极图片上传工具，无缝集成Obsidian、VS Code、Typora等主流编辑器。支持60+图床服务（GitHub、阿里云OSS、S3等），通过拖拽/粘贴/快捷键实现秒传并自动复制链接。独创插件系统可扩展支持Cloudflare R2等新兴存储，彻底消除写作中的上下文切换，让创作者专注内容生产。
repos.summary_en: PicGo is the ultimate image uploader for efficient creators, seamlessly integrating with Obsidian, VS Code, Typora and other editors. Supporting 60+ image hosts (GitHub, Alibaba Cloud OSS, AWS S3), it enables instant uploads via drag-and-drop/clipboard/hotkeys with auto-copied links. Its extensible plugin system adds support for Cloudflare R2 and more, eliminating context switching to maximize creative focus.

repos.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
repos.summary_zh: ddns-go 是一款用Go开发的轻量级动态域名解析工具，支持阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等20余家主流DNS服务商。可自动检测公网IPv4/IPv6地址变化并实时同步至域名记录，适用于家庭宽带、小型服务器等动态IP场景。提供Web管理界面、Docker部署方案及系统服务化运行能力，支持多平台、多架构与Webhook通知。
repos.summary_en: ddns-go is a lightweight Dynamic DNS client built with Golang, supporting 20+ major DNS providers like Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare and more. It automatically detects public IPv4/IPv6 address changes and synchronizes them to domain records in real-time, perfect for home broadband, small servers and IoT devices with dynamic IPs. The tool offers a user-friendly web interface, Docker deployment, system service integration, multi-platform compatibility (Windows/macOS/Linux, ARM/x86/RISC-V) and customizable webhook notifications.

repos.description: Open-source auth gateway connecting 1700+ SaaS providers to AI agents through SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP, and OpenAPI.
repos.summary_zh: OpenConnector 是开源 AI 智能体连接网关，替代 Pipedream/Composio。一次授权连接 1500+ SaaS（GitHub、Gmail、Notion 等），通过 SDK、CLI、MCP、HTTP/OpenAPI 暴露 10000+ 预置 Actions。支持凭证管理、可检查 Action 契约、策略控制与运行日志，可自托管（Docker/Node/K8s）或使用 OOMOL 托管运行时。
repos.summary_en: OpenConnector is an open-source auth gateway for AI agents, an alternative to Pipedream/Composio. Connect 1500+ SaaS providers once and expose 10,000+ prebuilt Actions via SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP and OpenAPI. It handles credentials, inspectable contracts, policies and logs, supporting self-hosting (Docker/Node/K8s) or OOMOL-hosted runtime.

repos.description: An index & manager of Onedrive based on serverless. Can be deployed to Vercel/Heroku/SCF/FG/FC/CFC/PHP web hosting/VPS.
repos.summary_zh: 一个基于Serverless架构的Onedrive文件管理器，支持Vercel、Heroku及国内云函数平台部署。通过生成直链实现用户直传直下载，大幅节省服务器带宽成本。提供可视化文件管理界面，支持多用户、多目录，适用于个人云盘分享、团队文档协作及静态资源托管场景。
repos.summary_en: A serverless-based OneDrive index and manager that enables seamless deployment across Vercel, Heroku, and major Chinese cloud function platforms including Tencent SCF, Huawei FG, Alibaba FC, and Baidu CFC. The system generates direct URLs allowing end-users to upload and download files directly through Microsoft's infrastructure, minimizing server bandwidth consumption to near zero. With an intuitive web interface supporting multi-user access and directory management, it transforms OneDrive into a fully functional cloud storage portal suitable for personal file sharing, team collaboration, and static website hosting. Its PHP implementation ensures broad compatibility with various hosting environments while maintaining low operational costs.

repos.description: This is a project that unifies the management of LLM APIs. It can call multiple backend services through a unified API interface, convert them to the OpenAI format uniformly, and support load balancing. Currently supported backend services include: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepBricks, OpenRouter, Gemini, Vertex, etc.
repos.summary_zh: uni-api 统一管理 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等主流 LLM API，转换为标准 OpenAI 格式。支持权重/地域/轮询四种负载均衡、自动重试与渠道冷却机制，纯配置文件管理，无前端依赖，适合个人部署。
repos.summary_en: uni-api unifies LLM APIs into OpenAI format. Supports 4 load balancing types, auto-retry, channel cooling, pure config management, no frontend, ideal for personal deployment.

repos.description: Graph database native to the cloud. Embedded, multi-tenant, built on object storage.
repos.summary_zh: NamiDB是一款基于对象存储的云原生图数据库引擎。它将节点和边以列式文件形式存于S3等桶中，桶为唯一真相源，支持Cypher查询。引擎支持嵌入式（如DuckDB）、HTTP服务器或云托管三种模式，利用S3条件写入实现多租户零协调架构。专为AI智能体构建知识图谱设计，成本可归零、备份简单，填补Kùzu归档后的空白。
repos.summary_en: NamiDB is a cloud-native graph database built on object storage. It persists nodes and edges as columnar files in S3 buckets, with the bucket as the single source of truth. It supports Cypher queries and runs embedded like DuckDB, as an HTTP server, or in hosted cloud using the same engine. S3 conditional writes enable multi-tenancy without consensus layers. Ideal for AI agents needing knowledge graphs, it offers zero-cost scaling and simple S3 backups. It fills the gap after Kùzu's archiving.

repos.summary_zh: 这个Python工具用于自动化破解阿里云滑动验证码。核心价值：通过OpenCV图像识别精准定位缺口位置，结合Selenium浏览器自动化模拟人类滑动轨迹，有效绕过阿里云验证码防护。应用场景：网络爬虫数据采集、自动化测试。技术亮点：集成ddddocr识别、undetected-chromedriver防检测、人类行为模拟算法，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: This Python tool automates bypassing Alibaba Cloud slider captchas. Its core value lies in using OpenCV for precise gap detection and Selenium for human-like drag simulation to effectively circumvent Aliyun captcha protection. It is ideal for web scraping data collection and automated testing scenarios. Key technical highlights include integration with ddddocr for recognition, undetected-chromedriver for anti-detection, sophisticated human behavior simulation algorithms, and full cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
